how_to_find: Ask the client for the newest file name in the supabase/migrations folder of their repo. Match its date to the list below. If they have no such folder, choose Not sure and send them the newest version steps.

versions.title: Setup wizard released
versions.summary: The setup wizard replaces the old Render guide. The app code is the same as the version before it.

changes.text: Deploy target is GitHub Pages, not Render

versions.title: Daily jobs use your own project
versions.summary: The three daily and weekly jobs no longer point at the Prismm project. They read the project address and key from your own database.

changes.text: Daily jobs sent calls to the Prismm project
project_url and project_anon_key settings in automation_config

upgrade_steps.title: Get the new database changes
upgrade_steps.text: Run these commands in your repo folder.

upgrade_steps.title: Set your project address and key
upgrade_steps.text: Open the SQL Editor in Supabase. Replace PASTE_YOUR_ANON_KEY with your anon public key from Project Settings, API.
upgrade_steps.copy:
update public.automation_config set value = '{{supabase_url}}' where key = 'project_url';
update public.automation_config set value = 'PASTE_YOUR_ANON_KEY' where key = 'project_anon_key';

versions.title: Daily auto-fire of schedules
versions.summary: Scheduled content now fires each day without a manual step. WARNING: installs from this version until 2026-09-02 send the daily call to the Prismm project. Upgrade these installs first.

changes.text: Daily job that fires due schedules
automation_config table with a secret for the job
